notes.title: ver 1.03 new occupation merchant added, other minor changes
notes.content:
Updated to ver 1.03.
A new occupation Merchant has been added and is available for immediate use.

Contents of update
・Merchant added.

Fixes
・Fixed a bug that prevented "direct use" of position-specific skills.
・Fixed a bug in which the range of the skill remained when directly using a foot skill.
・Fixed a bug in which some English translations were omitted.
・Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: ver 1.02 new occupation boxer added, other minor modifications
notes.content:
Updated to ver 1.02.
A new job, boxer, has been added and is now available.

Contents of update
・Boxer added.

Fixes
・Fixed the coold time of smash to 4 turns.
・Fixed a bug that caused a counter to be issued to the player.
・Fixed some omissions in English translation.
・Fixed other minor bugs

notes.title: ver 1.01 Now available in English
notes.content:
Now available in English

Can be changed from the options screen
